description: This Java class TS2C converts a specific tuner studio project file into a C data structure. It reads input files containing tables and bins, processes them, and outputs C array representations along with auxiliary bin data.

classes.name: TS2C
classes.description: Main class for converting tuner studio project data into C data structures and writing output files, handling input parsing, data processing, and C code generation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point; initializes the process with command line arguments.

methods.name: TS2C
methods.description: Constructor that processes input files, reads tables and bins, and generates C output.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts float arrays to comma-separated string representations.

methods.name: writeTable
methods.description: Writes the table data into a writer, inserting appropriate comments and formatting.

methods.name: readAndScroll
methods.description: Reads a file and advances to the line containing a specific key string.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a single row of table data with annotations into the C file.

methods.name: readTable
methods.description: Reads numerical data into a 2D float array from the input file.

methods.name: readAxle
methods.description: Reads a sequence of float values into a bin array from the input file.
